question: Please draw the perv-coo- ehm, I mean, Sanji at ages 40 and 60 in the future please. I'm counting on you. – Nara no Mi
answer: Very well. I received many requests about this. Enjoy! Top row: * Age 40: Whether it's a woman or food, I'm not picky. * Age 60: I'm going to go fishing in the All Blue. Bottom row (a future where something happened): * Age 40: As long as it fills my stomach, all food is the same. * Age 60: Drain the poison into the sea!!!
name: Gomu Nara no Mi
